post.title: Airzone wants €48 a year. Open Airzone Gateway is free.
post.caption: Five fresh grudges: remote heating control without Airzone's €48 a year, a read-aloud app without Speechify Premium, dictation without Wispr Flow Pro, and two more built instead of paying.

cues.say: November sixteenth.

segments.quote: In May 2026 Airzone announced the Airzone Cloud "Plan Cloud" subscription

cues.say: Air zone wants forty-eight euros a year

the Air zone Cloud, Plan Cloud, subscription.

cues.cap: So: Open Airzone Gateway. One ESP32.
cues.say: [quick] So: Open Air zone Gateway. One E S P thirty-two.
[smug] Free.
